seo.title: Home Yoga Classes in Bangalore | Sadhya | Sadhya Wellness Bangalore
seo.metaDescription: Book certified Home Yoga Classes in Bangalore. Personalized doorstep yoga sessions for pain relief, flexibility, strength & overall wellness. Call now today!

services.title: Personalized Holistic Yoga Assessment
services.shortDescription: A comprehensive initial home consultation and custom posture evaluation followed by a tailored 60-minute practice designed around your lifestyle.

services.title: Couple & Family Home Yoga
services.shortDescription: A shared interactive yoga session tailored for two or more family members to practice together, fostering bonding, balance, and shared vitality.

services.title: Stress & Relaxation Yoga
services.shortDescription: Deep restorative poses combined with calming pranayama to release nervous system tension and promote restful sleep after long work hours.
services.alt: Practitioner resting deeply in a restorative yoga pose with supportive cushions.

services.title: Senior Citizen Yoga Practice
services.shortDescription: A safe, slow-paced session focusing on joint mobility, balance, and gentle restorative breathing modified for older adults in their own living room.
services.alt: Senior adult receiving gentle guidance during a personalized home yoga session.

services.title: Beginner Gentle Yoga Session
services.shortDescription: A patient, step-by-step introduction to foundational postures and breathing exercises. Ideal for anyone beginning their wellness journey in total comfort.
services.alt: Beginner practitioner practicing mindful breathing exercises on a comfortable mat.

services.title: Back, Neck & Mobility Support
services.shortDescription: Targeted gentle stretches and spinal alignment techniques created specifically to relieve desk fatigue, neck tightness, and lower back discomfort.
services.alt: Yoga instructor assisting client with gentle spinal alignment and posture relief.

services.title: Weight Management Yoga Support
services.shortDescription: An invigorating flow combining energetic vinyasa movement and mindful breathwork to boost metabolic health and build lean endurance at home.
services.alt: Woman practicing active yoga flow for weight management at home.

services.title: Fitness & Flexibility Yoga Session
services.shortDescription: A dynamic 1-on-1 home session tailored to deepen your range of motion, build core stamina, and revitalize your energy levels. Designed around your daily routine and fitness goals.
services.alt: Personal yoga instructor guiding flexibility posture in a sunlit living room.
